name: uv_loop_init

ownership.argument: Producer of the loop layout: it fixes the ready-queue head, the mutex, the async handle, the per-loop state allocation and both pipe descriptor slots.

provenance.source: Memsets 624 bytes, allocates the 288-byte state into loop+20, initialises the mutex at loop+76 with uv_mutex_init 0xC2DCCCC, self-links the intrusive queues at +8, +40, +48, +68, +280, +288, +296, +304 and +312, stores -1 in the 64-bit word at +360 and at +392, and calls uv_async_init 0xC2E14E8 on loop+104. It also asserts the empty ready queue at +68 while holding +76.

notes: queue head +68, mutex +76, async +104, pipe descriptors +360/+364, loop state +20 (288 bytes). The +312 list is not a descriptor slot on this build.
